# SparseGF2 v3

> Fast stabilizer (Clifford) circuit simulator for monitored random Clifford circuits:
> measurement-induced and purification transitions, dynamically generated codes, erasure
> protection. Reads Stim's circuit language; verified against Stim. Python package
> `sparsegf2_v3`, CLI `sparsegf2`, MCP server `sparsegf2-mcp`.

Agents should use the MCP server (`claude mcp add sparsegf2 -- sparsegf2-mcp`) or
`sparsegf2 <command> --json`. Every result is a compact JSON summary (under about 8000
characters); pass `output_dir` to save full arrays. Seeds are ints; qubit lists are
`[0, 1]` or `"0:2"`; system qubits are 0..n-1 and reference qubits follow.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): install, which entry point to use, five-minute tour, conventions, pitfalls
- [docs/LLM_INTERFACE.md](docs/LLM_INTERFACE.md): full CLI and MCP reference with examples and client registration
- [README.md](README.md): project status, install, and the Python library tour
- [docs/LITERATURE.md](docs/LITERATURE.md): the observables the monitored-circuit literature uses and how they are computed
- [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md): architecture, data layout and benchmarks

## Code

- [src/sparsegf2_v3/api.py](src/sparsegf2_v3/api.py): JSON service layer (capabilities, inspect_circuit, run_circuit, run_ensemble, estimate_ensemble, start_ensemble_job, job_status, cancel_job, list_jobs, load_results)
- [src/sparsegf2_v3/mipt.py](src/sparsegf2_v3/mipt.py): MonitoredCircuit protocol, probes, EnsembleResult
- [src/sparsegf2_v3/observables.py](src/sparsegf2_v3/observables.py): entropies, code dimension, erasure statistics, contiguous distance
- [src/sparsegf2_v3/simulator.py](src/sparsegf2_v3/simulator.py): Simulator (stim.TableauSimulator-style API)
- [src/sparsegf2_v3/circuit.py](src/sparsegf2_v3/circuit.py): Circuit (Stim syntax, CLIFFORD_1Q/2Q extensions)
- [examples/](examples/): complete study scripts (purification time on Watts-Strogatz graphs, transition scans, code and erasure vs depth)
